glyph.isekai_mahou.holy_ray.desc: A ray of light strikes the target from the sky. Double damage to undead and demons, which also burn.
glyph.isekai_mahou.heal.desc: Heals an ally. Inverted, the light burns the enemy (stronger against undead).
glyph.isekai_mahou.regenerate.desc: Strong Regeneration for a few seconds. Inverted, makes the enemy wither.
glyph.isekai_mahou.blind.desc: A dazzling flash: players are blinded and mobs lose their target.
glyph.isekai_mahou.reveal.desc: The target glows through walls. Invisible ones lose invisibility and become Exposed. On yourself, reveals the area.
glyph.isekai_mahou.purify.desc: Removes negative effects and fire from an ally. Inverted, strips the enemy's positive effects.
glyph.isekai_mahou.blessing.desc: Strength and Absorption for 30 seconds. Inverted, causes Weakness and Slowness.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sunlight.desc: Concentrated sunlight: burns undead, dazzles everyone else and makes plants grow.
glyph.isekai_mahou.summon_guardian_fairy: Summons a fairy of light that flies around you, heals wounded allies and strikes the undead.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sacred_barrier.desc: Raises a dome of light that hostile undead and demons cannot enter: they are pushed out and burn.
glyph.isekai_mahou.exorcise.desc: Massive damage to undead, demons and shadows. Little effect on anything else.
glyph.isekai_mahou.prism.desc: The light splits into 3 colored beams that bounce between nearby enemies.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sanctuary.desc: Creates a sacred circle that heals allies and grants Resistance while they stand inside.
glyph.isekai_mahou.resurrection.desc: Legendary. For 60 seconds the ally cannot die: when they fall, they rise with half health and a wave of light heals everyone around.
glyph.isekai_mahou.life_drain.desc: Shadow damage; you recover half of the stolen life.
glyph.isekai_mahou.weaken.desc: Inflicts Weakness on the target (and Mining Fatigue, with more power).
glyph.isekai_mahou.fear.desc: Mobs drop their target and flee from you. On yourself, terrifies every enemy around.
glyph.isekai_mahou.darkness.desc: Wraps the target in darkness: Darkness and Blindness, and mobs lose their target.
glyph.isekai_mahou.shadow_step.desc: You pass through the shadows and appear behind the target. On yourself, goes to the enemy in front of you.
glyph.isekai_mahou.chains.desc: Shadow chains burst from the ground and hold the target in place.
glyph.isekai_mahou.curse.desc: Corrupts the target with lasting shadow damage and Bad Luck.
glyph.isekai_mahou.invisibility.desc: You vanish into the shadows: you become invisible and pursuers lose your trail.
glyph.isekai_mahou.living_shadow.desc: Summons a shadow clone of yourself that defends you and attacks your enemies.
glyph.isekai_mahou.devour.desc: The shadows devour 15% of the target's max health (+4) and you heal for half.
glyph.isekai_mahou.pain_link.desc: For 10 seconds, half the damage the target takes spreads to enemies near it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.steal_blessing.desc: Steals the target's positive effects for yourself (or its Absorption).
glyph.isekai_mahou.nightmare.desc: Traps the target in a nightmare: nausea, slowness, fear, whispers and psychic damage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.possession.desc: Legendary. Controls a weak mob (up to 20 hearts, never a boss) for 30 seconds: it fights by your side.
message.isekai_mahou.possession_start: %s is under your control for %s seconds.
message.isekai_mahou.possession_resisted: %s is too strong to be possessed!
message.isekai_mahou.resurrection_saved: The Grace of Resurrection brought %s back!
message.isekai_mahou.shadow_step_blocked: There is no free shadow to step into.
